statement: The comparative trial for 'DrisBlueTwentyThree' was carried out by Expert Agriculture Team Ltd. at Chilliwack, British Columbia in the 2023 growing season in a randomised complete block design of four replicates of three plants per variety with measurements taken from ten plants, against 'DrisBlueSeven' (Stella Blue) and 'DrisBlueTwentyTwo' (Regina). The fruit is described as medium size, oblate, firm, with medium sweetness and medium-high acidity.
